name: smwgraphics-super-mario-maker-super-mario-world-graphics-swap-pack
title: Super Mario Maker: Super Mario World - Graphics Swap Pack
description:
I have noticed that Super Mario Maker had changed a lot of Sprites in the game and I felt inspired to make the changes to the GFX for people to make their hacks have polishes for creativity some are just fixed pixels while same are brand new sprite changes. Magikoopa had the biggest changes due to the original Super Mario Maker sprites being too small so I combined the bodies between the original and Mario Makers! To change the color of the new Para-Bomb and Bubble Bob-ombs use Tweaker and choose Palette B.

I didn't include.

-Turning Yoshi Body due to size being too wide.
-New Dry Bones due to size.
-No new Line guides.
-No new Lakitu Cloud.
-No new Door.
